title: 油债双升压制科技，本地CPO回购与晶圆扩产形成对冲；新意网、盛科待开盘验证 + 美股盘前：油债共振压制科技，GTLB与DELL财报获奖赏；MDB、PANW、CRDO遭惩罚
summary: 油价与美债收益率上行、美股科技普跌；中际旭创首次回购3.18亿元、华虹宏力三期扩产为CPO与晶圆代工提供本地对冲，新意网与盛科催化仍待量价验证。 标普500、纳指100和道指期指约跌0.29%、0.55%和0.16%，Brent约95.18美元、10年期美债收益率约4.82%；ADP仅增3.8万。GTLB、DELL财报后约涨20.9%和9.1%，HPE与NTAP获得正向映射；MDB、PANW、CRDO因负价格反馈只作风险观察。今晚关注AVGO、SNOW、HPE、NTAP、NTSK。

利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
美伊冲突推高油价与收益率，美股三大指数集体收跌
9月1日美股收盘，标普500跌0.71%、道指跌0.79%、纳指跌1.00%，纳指100跌1.29%；WTI与Brent分别涨4.65%和4.51%，美国10年期收益率升至4.803%。事实是能源冲击与折现率同步上升；判断是A/H油气、油服与油运相对占优，高久期科技、航空及能源下游承压。
政策
外籍个人从外商投资企业取得股息红利改按20%缴纳个税
财政部、税务总局2026年第27号公告自9月1日起执行，结束相关免税安排，并明确企业代扣代缴。该变化直接提高部分外籍股东的税后股息成本，短线可能压制高股息外资偏好，但对企业利润表无直接影响；重点看高外资持股、高派息公司是否出现相对弱势。
政策
三部门发布汽车行业境外竞争与合规建设指引
商务部、工信部、市场监管总局要求汽车企业境外经营遵循依法合规、公平竞争，并以成本和当地供求为基础定价，覆盖促销、知识产权、数据和供应链。长期利于有全球合规体系的整车与零部件龙头；短线增加出海定价、营销和合规成本，不能简单解读为出口刺激。
科技
美股科技去风险扩散，能源与少数防御股逆势
Futu收盘快照显示TSLA -3.22%、MU -2.64%、LITE -5.01%、ALAB -5.75%、TER -4.11%、PANW -5.24%、CRWD -6.90%，而AAPL +2.61%、XOM +2.24%、CVX +2.38%。A/H映射是光通信、存储、网络安全先看承接而非追涨；油气相对强势得到个股确认。
科技
盛科通信拟定增不超48.05亿元，加码下一代高性能交换芯片
公司9月1日盘后披露，募资主要用于面向Scale-up与Scale-out的下一代交换芯片、互联软硬件与协议研究，核心项目计划周期四年。产业逻辑指向国产算力网络核心元器件补短板；交易风险是发行稀释、研发周期长，以及隔夜美股半导体和光通信显著回撤。
科技
燧原科技今日科创板申购，AI芯片一级市场迎来61亿元融资检验
燧原科技发行价142.18元、发行4303.52万股，预计募资总额约61.2亿元，对应2025年摊薄静态市销率61.8倍，公司尚未盈利。事件提升国产训练/推理芯片关注度，但高估值、亏损状态和隔夜科技股回撤使二级映射更应等待成交确认。
财报
新意网全年利润增17%，AI高密度数据中心需求推动扩建
新意网（01686）全年收入31.17亿港元、同比+6%，EBITDA 23.00亿港元、+8%，股东应占利润11.46亿港元、+17%，末期息每股14港仙；MEGA IDC一期大客户进驻后占用率预计超70%，二期整体加速至2028年。09:13 CST买盘指示5.15港元、较前收4.89港元高5.32%，但尚无成交，不能视为正式价格反馈。
财报
NIO收入与EPS均低于一致预期，美股收跌4.02%
Futu财报日历显示蔚来（09866/NIO）Q2收入321.37亿元，较一致预期332.77亿元低3.43%；EPS -0.29元，差于预期-0.2214元。美股NIO收4.06美元、较前收4.23美元跌4.02%，构成明确负反馈；H股不宜把亏损收窄单独解读为利好，需看毛利、交付与现金消耗。
财报
腾讯音乐半年收入增长、利润下滑，并启动高级无抵押票据发行
腾讯音乐（01698）H1收入168.28亿元、同比+6.5%，股东应占利润45.62亿元、同比-31.9%；完成喜马拉雅收购后，6月底借款升至131.39亿元。公司同步披露拟发行高级无抵押票据。增长与整合协同是正面，利润回落、杠杆上升及新票据定价是风险；港股尚未形成发布后成交反馈。
公司
福寿园出现极深折价部分要约，欧康维视获眼科药注册受理
福寿园（01448）潜在要约人拟以每股0.10港元收购最多1.15亿股、约占已发行股本4.96%，较停牌前2.64港元折让96.21%，且要约有不可豁免前提、股份继续停牌，不能视为正常溢价并购。欧康维视（01477）国产地塞米松玻璃体内植入剂注册申请获受理，属于监管里程碑但尚非获批。
公告
中际旭创首次回购3.18亿元，CPO链获得本地承接信号
公司9月1日首次回购37.41万股，占总股本0.0318%，成交价838.16—870.00元，支付3.18亿元。事实是管理层实施了明确资本行动；判断是它可对冲LITE现金盘下跌5.01%对光通信链的映射压力，但回购比例仍小，只有开盘强于创业板和光模块板块并放量才构成确认。
公告
华虹宏力三期增资扩产，12英寸特色工艺产能再加码
上交所9月2日公告显示，华虹宏力拟联合多方对无锡华虹宏力三期增资，建设约5.5万片/月的12英寸特色工艺晶圆代工产线；本次增资合计41.63亿元，尚需股东大会审议。事实利好本土晶圆代工资本开支预期，但投产周期、稀释与隔夜半导体下跌仍限制追高空间。

美股夜盘行情总结

指数
夜盘指数：可靠实时夜盘报价不可得
在09:20—09:25 CST增量复核期间，Futu OpenD连接超时；Web行情可核验的最新成交仍是9月1日美股现金时段收盘：QQQ 707.64/-1.28%、SPY 761.78/-0.71%、DIA 527.75/-0.74%，最后成交约07:54—07:59 CST。它们不是当前夜盘，故夜盘方向标记为不可得，不以旧价冒充。
对照
板块对照：双榜仍缺失，现金盘只显示能源确认、科技承压
Moomoo行业榜与Sparks概念榜全分页均被频控、面板各输出0行，无法逐项取得Top5/Bottom5代表股夜盘，因此不能给出完整确认、背离或潜在反转判定。现金时段XOM +2.24%、LITE -5.01%只说明能源确认、光通信承压，不代表当前夜盘延续。
映射
A/H映射：CPO回购与晶圆扩产形成本地对冲
中际旭创3.18亿元首次回购、华虹宏力三期41.63亿元增资，以及新意网/盛科公告共同提高本地科技事件强度。只有相关标的开盘守住前收、强于创业板/科创50/恒生科技并放量，才算对美股科技压力形成背离；失守前收则仍按风险确认处理。

盘前结论

事实：油价与美债收益率同步上升，美股指数和大多数科技代表股下跌；NIO财报后收跌4.02%。能源股确认油价传导，新意网业绩与国产算力芯片融资提供局部支点。

判断：基准情景是油气相对占优、科技内部强事件胜于泛主题。盛科、新意网与AI芯片映射必须用开盘30分钟量价确认，避免在高利率环境无条件追高。

不确定性：Moomoo两组完整排行均失败；美伊冲突、油价、收益率和港股停牌事件可快速改变路径。以守住前收、相对指数强弱与成交扩张为最终验证。

重点个股推荐

新意网集团
01686
业绩增长

推荐理由：收入、EBITDA和利润分别增6%、8%、17%，AI高密度机柜需求推动MEGA IDC扩建。

触发因素：开盘守住4.89港元并放量，首小时强于恒生科技。

风险点：09:13仅为无成交买盘指示；资本开支、客户集中和海缆竞争。

盛科通信-U
688702
国产算力

推荐理由：48.05亿元融资指向Scale-up/Scale-out交换芯片，产业方向明确。

触发因素：不出现失控高开，守住369.22元并强于半导体/科创50。

风险点：定增稀释、四年研发周期与隔夜半导体下跌。

中国海洋石油
00883 / 600938
油价映射

推荐理由：WTI/Brent涨逾4.5%，XOM/CVX/COP同步上涨，能源传导已获美股确认。

触发因素：原油守住涨幅，A/H开盘强于各自大盘且成交扩张。

风险点：美伊突然降级、油价冲高回落和政策干预。

蔚来-SW
09866
仅观察

推荐理由：不作多头推荐；收入与EPS均低于预期且美股已有-4.02%负反馈，只用于风险观察。

触发因素：H股止跌、收复31.06港元并出现毛利/现金流改善证据后再评估。

风险点：价格竞争、交付兑现、现金消耗及美股负反馈传导。

中际旭创
300308
CPO回购

推荐理由：首次回购支付3.18亿元，为LITE下跌后的A股光模块映射提供本地资本行动对冲。

触发因素：开盘守住838.16元回购区间下沿，强于创业板与光模块板块并放量。

风险点：回购仅占总股本0.0318%，隔夜光通信下跌、估值与高位波动可能压过催化。

板块轮动看板

相对强势油气、油服、油运；油价与美股能源股形成双重确认。
事件驱动数据中心、国产交换芯片、CPO回购、特色工艺扩产和AI芯片IPO，优先选择公告量化最充分的标的。
压力区高久期科技、光通信、网络安全、航空及能源下游；美债与油价同时施压。
政策观察外籍股息税影响高股息外资偏好；汽车出海指引提升长期规范性但增加合规成本。

逻辑链条

美伊冲突升级 → 原油涨逾4.5%、10年期美债升至4.803% → 能源盈利弹性上升、成长估值折现率上升。
QQQ、LITE与科技代表股普跌 → A/H泛科技承接概率下降 → 中际回购、华虹扩产及盛科/新意网公告须以相对强势和成交量形成背离。
外籍股息税20% → 部分外籍投资者税后收益下降 → 高派息外资重仓股短线相对表现需观察。
NIO低预期与美股负反馈 → H股开盘压力上升 → 未止跌前只观察，不因亏损收窄追多。

风险雷达

地缘与油价跳升

进一步打击或航运中断可推高油价、通胀与收益率，也可能导致航空和消费链二次下修。

科技估值压缩

10年期收益率4.803%，CRWD、PANW、ALAB与LITE大跌；本地科技催化可能被宏观折现率盖过。

深折价要约误读

福寿园0.10港元要约价较停牌前收盘折让96.21%，且有不可豁免前提、继续停牌，不是正常溢价并购。

覆盖缺口

Moomoo行业与Sparks均未完成全分页，两个排行组输出0行；首屏只用于发现，不能推断完整广度。

盘前指示非成交

新意网5.15港元是09:13无成交买盘指示；正式反馈须等待开盘成交和量价持续性。

数据来源与时间点

来源与时间：财政部/税务总局、商务部/工信部/市场监管总局、上交所/深交所公司公告，金十、财联社/科创板日报、东方财富盘前交叉。08:50首轮账本291条/51条必审；09:10增量全量复核截至09:25合并292条、54条必审、25条硬触发、0条待决，新增HKEX公告0条，新增Futu日历增强3条，`--validate`通过。进入正文2条：中际旭创首次回购、华虹宏力三期扩产；信和置业与尖沙咀置业业绩未改变地产板块判断。Moomoo行业145项与Sparks 106项全分页继续频控、面板各0行；Futu OpenD 09:20连接超时，Web行情仅核验到07:54—07:59现金收盘，可靠夜盘报价不可得。复核抓取/更新时间：2026-09-02 09:32 CST。

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 denotes heat and importance, not percentage moves.
Major News Summary
Global
US-Iran escalation lifts oil and yields as all three US indexes fall
On September 1 the S&P 500 fell 0.71%, Dow 0.79%, Nasdaq 1.00% and Nasdaq-100 1.29%. WTI and Brent rose 4.65% and 4.51%, while the US 10-year yield reached 4.803%. Energy and discount-rate shocks are occurring together, favoring relative A/H oil, services and shipping while pressuring long-duration tech, airlines and energy users.
Policy
Foreign individuals now pay 20% tax on dividends from foreign-invested enterprises
Finance Ministry and tax authority Notice No. 27 took effect September 1, ending the prior exemption and requiring withholding. It directly reduces after-tax dividend income for affected foreign holders but does not directly change company earnings. Watch whether high-yield names with heavy foreign ownership underperform.
Policy
Three ministries issue overseas-competition and compliance guidance for automakers
The Commerce, Industry and Market Regulation ministries require lawful and fair overseas competition, cost- and local-demand-based pricing, and controls covering promotions, IP, data and supply chains. Global leaders may benefit over time, but overseas pricing, marketing and compliance costs rise; this is not a simple export stimulus.
Technology
US technology de-risking broadens while energy and a few defensives resist
Futu closing snapshots show TSLA -3.22%, MU -2.64%, LITE -5.01%, ALAB -5.75%, TER -4.11%, PANW -5.24% and CRWD -6.90%, while AAPL rose 2.61%, XOM 2.24% and CVX 2.38%. A/H optical, memory and security names need opening support rather than automatic chasing; energy transmission is confirmed.
Technology
Centec plans up to RMB4.805 billion placement for next-generation switching chips
The September 1 after-close filing funds Scale-up and Scale-out switching chips plus interconnect software, hardware and protocol research; the core project runs four years. It directly targets domestic compute-network bottlenecks. Risks are dilution, long development cycles and the overnight selloff in US semiconductors and optical networking.
Technology
Enflame opens STAR Market subscription, testing a RMB6.12 billion AI-chip financing
Enflame is priced at RMB142.18 for 43.035 million shares, implying roughly RMB6.12 billion gross proceeds and a 61.8x 2025 diluted price-to-sales ratio; it remains unprofitable. The IPO raises attention on domestic training and inference chips, but valuation, losses and weak overnight tech require local volume confirmation.
Earnings
SUNeVision profit rises 17% as AI data-centre demand accelerates expansion
SUNeVision (01686) reported HK$3.117 billion revenue, +6%, HK$2.300 billion EBITDA, +8%, and HK$1.146 billion attributable profit, +17%, with a HK14-cent final dividend. A large MEGA IDC Phase One commitment should lift occupancy above 70%, and Phase Two is accelerated for 2028. A HK$5.15 bid at 09:13 CST was 5.32% above the HK$4.89 close but had no trade, so it is not formal feedback.
Earnings
NIO misses revenue and EPS consensus and closes 4.02% lower in New York
Futu's calendar shows Q2 revenue of RMB32.137 billion, 3.43% below RMB33.277 billion consensus, and EPS of -RMB0.29 versus -RMB0.2214 expected. The ADR closed at $4.06 versus $4.23, a clear negative reaction. The H share should not treat narrower losses alone as bullish; gross margin, deliveries and cash burn matter.
Earnings
TME grows first-half revenue but profit falls as it proposes senior notes
Tencent Music (01698) posted H1 revenue of RMB16.828 billion, +6.5%, while attributable profit fell 31.9% to RMB4.562 billion. Following the Ximalaya acquisition, borrowings reached RMB13.139 billion at June 30. A proposed senior-unsecured note offering adds financing-cost and leverage questions; no post-release Hong Kong trade exists yet.
Companies
Fu Shou Yuan receives a deep-discount partial offer; Ocumension gets a drug-filing acceptance
A potential offeror proposes HK$0.10 for up to 115 million Fu Shou Yuan shares, 4.96% of issued capital and 96.21% below the HK$2.64 pre-suspension close. Non-waivable preconditions apply and trading remains suspended, so this is not a normal premium takeover. Ocumension's domestic dexamethasone intravitreal implant application was accepted, a regulatory milestone but not approval.
Filing
Zhongji Innolight starts a RMB318 million buyback, adding a local CPO support signal
On September 1 the company repurchased 374,100 shares for the first time, 0.0318% of shares outstanding, at RMB838.16—870.00 for RMB318 million. The capital action is factual and may offset the mapping from LITE's 5.01% cash-session drop, but the share count is small; confirmation requires outperformance versus ChiNext and optical modules on expanding opening volume.
Filing
Hua Hong Macro expands phase three, adding 12-inch specialty-process capacity
A September 2 SSE filing says Hua Hong Macro and partners plan a RMB4.163 billion capital increase in Wuxi Hua Hong Macro Phase III to build about 55,000 12-inch specialty-process wafers per month, subject to shareholder approval. It supports domestic foundry capex expectations, but the buildout cycle, dilution and the overnight semiconductor selloff limit gap-chasing.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Indexes
Overnight Indexes: reliable live overnight quotes are unavailable
During the 09:20—09:25 CST incremental review, Futu OpenD timed out. The latest trades verifiable from web quotes remained September 1 cash-session closes: QQQ 707.64/-1.28%, SPY 761.78/-0.71% and DIA 527.75/-0.74%, last traded around 07:54—07:59 CST. They are not current overnight prices, so overnight direction is marked unavailable rather than inferred from stale quotes.
Comparison
Sector Comparison: both rankings remain unavailable; cash trading only confirms energy over tech
Full Moomoo industry and Sparks concept pagination remained rate-limited and each panel publishes zero rows, so Top5/Bottom5 representatives cannot be checked overnight and a complete confirmation, divergence or potential-reversal call is unavailable. Cash-session XOM +2.24% and LITE -5.01% only show energy confirmation and optical pressure, not current overnight continuation.
Mapping
A/H Mapping: the CPO buyback and foundry expansion create a local offset
Zhongji Innolight's RMB318 million first buyback, Hua Hong Macro Phase III's RMB4.163 billion capital increase and the SUNeVision/Centec filings raise local event strength. Holding prior closes, outperforming ChiNext/STAR 50/Hang Seng Tech and expanding volume would create divergence from US tech pressure; losing prior closes would confirm the risk.

Pre-open Conclusion

Fact: oil and Treasury yields rose together, US indexes and most technology representatives fell, and NIO closed 4.02% lower after results.Energy stocks confirmed oil transmission, while SUNeVision earnings and domestic compute-chip financing offer local support.

View: the base case favors relative energy strength and strong company-specific tech events over broad themes.Centec, SUNeVision and AI-chip mappings require price-volume confirmation in the first 30 minutes.

Uncertainty: both complete Moomoo ranking groups failed; conflict, oil, yields and suspended-stock events can change the path quickly. Prior-close holds, relative strength and volume expansion are the final tests.

Key Stock Setups

SUNeVision
01686
Earnings growth

Rationale: Revenue, EBITDA and profit rose 6%, 8% and 17%, with AI high-density demand accelerating MEGA IDC.

Trigger: Hold HK$4.89 with volume and outperform Hang Seng Tech in the first hour.

Risk: The HK$5.15 quote was an untraded bid; capex, customer concentration and cable competition.

Centec Networks
688702
Domestic compute

Rationale: RMB4.805 billion targets Scale-up/Scale-out switch chips with a concrete industrial direction.

Trigger: Avoid an uncontrolled gap, hold RMB369.22 and outperform semiconductors/STAR 50.

Risk: Placement dilution, four-year development timeline and the overnight chip selloff.

CNOOC
00883 / 600938
Oil mapping

Rationale: WTI/Brent rose over 4.5%, with XOM/CVX/COP also higher, confirming US energy transmission.

Trigger: Oil holds gains and both listings outperform their local indexes on expanding volume.

Risk: Sudden de-escalation, an oil reversal and policy intervention.

NIO-SW
09866
Watch only

Rationale: Not a bullish pick; revenue and EPS missed and the ADR fell 4.02%, making it a risk watch.

Trigger: Stabilize, reclaim HK$31.06 and show evidence of improving margin/cash flow before reassessment.

Risk: Price competition, delivery execution, cash burn and ADR weakness transmitting to Hong Kong.

Zhongji Innolight
300308
CPO buyback

Rationale: The RMB318 million first buyback provides a local capital-action offset to the A-share optical mapping from LITE's decline.

Trigger: Hold the RMB838.16 lower bound of the buyback range and outperform ChiNext and optical modules on expanding volume.

Risk: Only 0.0318% of shares were repurchased; overnight optical weakness, valuation and high-level volatility may overwhelm the catalyst.

Sector Rotation Board

Relative strengthOil producers, services and shipping; oil and US energy stocks provide dual confirmation.
Event drivenData centres, domestic switching chips, the CPO buyback, specialty-process expansion and the AI-chip IPO; prefer quantified filings.
PressureLong-duration tech, optical networking, cybersecurity, airlines and energy users face both yields and oil.
Policy watchThe dividend tax affects foreign high-yield demand; auto guidance improves discipline but raises compliance costs.

Logic Chain

US-Iran escalation → oil gains above 4.5% and the 10-year reaches 4.803% → energy earnings leverage rises while growth discount rates rise.
QQQ, LITE and tech representatives fall → broad A/H tech support weakens → Zhongji's buyback, Hua Hong's expansion and Centec/SUNeVision filings need relative strength and volume to create divergence.
A 20% foreign-individual dividend tax → lower after-tax returns for some investors → watch relative performance in high-payout, foreign-owned names.
NIO misses and receives negative ADR feedback → H-share opening pressure rises → watch only until price stabilizes.

Risk Radar

Geopolitical and oil jump

Further strikes or shipping disruption can lift oil, inflation and yields and trigger second-round downgrades in airlines and consumers.

Tech valuation compression

The 10-year is 4.803%, while CRWD, PANW, ALAB and LITE plunged; macro discount rates may overwhelm local catalysts.

Deep-discount offer misread

Fu Shou Yuan's HK$0.10 price is 96.21% below the pre-suspension close, has non-waivable preconditions and is not a normal premium acquisition.

Coverage gap

Neither Moomoo industry nor Sparks completed full pagination; both ranking groups contain zero rows and first pages are discovery only.

Bid is not a trade

SUNeVision's HK$5.15 at 09:13 was an untraded bid; formal feedback requires open-market volume and persistence.

Data Sources and Timestamp

Sources and times: Finance Ministry/Tax Authority; Commerce, Industry and Market Regulation ministries; SSE/SZSE company filings; and Jin10, CLS/STAR Market Daily and Eastmoney pre-open cross-checks. The 08:50 ledger had 291 notices/51 must-review items; the 09:10 full-window review through 09:25 merged 292 entries, 54 must-review items, 25 hard triggers and zero pending decisions, with zero new HKEX notices and three Futu-calendar enrichments; `--validate` passed. Two omissions enter the brief: Zhongji Innolight's first buyback and Hua Hong Macro Phase III expansion; Sino Land and TST Properties did not change the property-sector view. Full pagination for 145 Moomoo industries and 106 Sparks concepts remained rate-limited, leaving both panels at zero rows. Futu OpenD timed out at 09:20 and web quotes only verified 07:54—07:59 cash closes, so reliable overnight quotes are unavailable. Review fetch/update: 2026-09-02 09:32 CST.

entries.title: 美股盘前：油债共振压制科技，GTLB与DELL财报获奖赏；MDB、PANW、CRDO遭惩罚
entries.summary: 标普500、纳指100和道指期指约跌0.29%、0.55%和0.16%，Brent约95.18美元、10年期美债收益率约4.82%；ADP仅增3.8万。GTLB、DELL财报后约涨20.9%和9.1%，HPE与NTAP获得正向映射；MDB、PANW、CRDO因负价格反馈只作风险观察。今晚关注AVGO、SNOW、HPE、NTAP、NTSK。
entries.html:
关键资产图

标普500期指
-0.29% 偏弱
纳指100期指
-0.55% 科技承压
道指期指
-0.16% 相对抗跌
Brent原油
+0.60% 通胀压力
美债10年期
4.82% 估值压制
半导体ETF SMH
现金盘-2.04%

关键词云图

油价冲击债券抛售科技承压GTLB财报DELL上调MDB负反馈CRDO利润率PANW惩罚ADP放缓AVGO财报SNOW消费滞胀交易
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
地缘
美伊互相打击升级，Brent升至约95.18美元
Reuters 7:20 ET报道，美国打击霍尔木兹附近的伊朗军事目标，伊朗称已袭击地区内美国资产；Brent涨0.6%至95.18美元。事实是供应中断风险溢价再升，判断是能源通胀将继续抬高美债期限溢价，升级路径仍高度不确定。
债市
全球债券抛售加深，美国10年期收益率逼近4.82%
Reuters记录美国10年期收益率约4.8182%、接近三年高位，日本10年期收益率连续第二日高于3%。更高油价叠加财政担忧，使高久期科技最先承压；若收益率突破4.82%，盘中估值压缩可能再扩大。
数据
ADP仅增3.8万，低于预期但未能压低长债收益率
ADP官方称8月私人就业增加3.8万，为1月以来最慢，低于4.7万至4.8万一致预期；制造业减少1.7万，专业商业服务减少1.6万。就业放缓本应偏鸽，但油价推高通胀尾部风险，市场面临增长弱、利率仍高的组合。
期指
期指偏弱但非失速，纳指100继续落后
TipRanks约8:07 ET显示标普500、纳指100和道指期指分别约跌0.29%、0.55%和0.16%；AP同时记录日经跌2.9%、韩国KOSPI跌近4%。事实是全球去风险集中在芯片与成长，而不是所有行业同步崩跌。
财报
Dell创纪录并大幅上调全年展望，盘前涨约9.1%
Dell Q2收入470亿美元、同比增58%，非GAAP EPS 7.04美元；全年收入指引升至1920亿美元，非GAAP EPS升至25.50美元。TipRanks记录盘前约463.68美元、涨9.1%、成交约20.3万股，业绩与价格反馈一致。
财报
GitLab净ARR增长超过40%，盘前涨约20.9%
GitLab Q2收入2.863亿美元、同比增21%，净ARR增长超过40%，非GAAP经营利润率15%；Q3收入指引2.81亿至2.83亿美元。TipRanks记录盘前约54.53美元、涨20.9%、成交约12.9万股，成为科技财报中最清晰的正反馈。
财报
MongoDB双超并上调指引，盘前仍跌约13.6%
MongoDB Q2收入7.718亿美元、同比增30%，非GAAP EPS 1.90美元，均高于市场预期；全年收入指引上调至29.9亿至30.3亿美元。尽管基本面改善，盘前跌至约375.25美元，说明估值、未来增速和高预期压过当季beat；只作风险观察、回避追多。
财报
Palo Alto连续beat仍被卖出，平台化预期门槛过高
公开业绩汇总显示PANW EPS约1.02美元、高于约1.00美元一致预期，并给出FY27收入141亿至142亿美元指引；但盘前仍约跌2%。高估值、并购整合与平台化增长门槛令beat不足以推动股价，等待止跌确认。
财报
Credo营收高速增长，但利润率展望触发约8.8%跌幅
Credo当季收入与EPS均超过一致预期，下一季收入指引5.25亿至5.35亿美元也高于约5.14亿美元预期；但利润率展望压过增长，盘前约跌8.8%。按价格反馈约束，CRDO降级至风险雷达，等待毛利率与客户集中度担忧消化。
今夜
AVGO、SNOW、HPE、NTAP与NTSK盘后接力
公司IR与多份财报日历确认五家公司均在9月2日盘后披露。Broadcom检验AI芯片与网络需求，Snowflake检验消费型云数据支出，HPE与NetApp检验企业基础设施，Netskope检验云安全；在“好数字也会下跌”的环境中，指引比headline beat更重要。

盘前结论

事实：纳指100期指约跌0.55%，美国10年期收益率约4.82%，Brent约95.18美元；油价与利率共同压制成长估值。GTLB与DELL财报后分别约涨20.9%和9.1%，正反馈明确。

判断：基准情景是指数小幅低开、能源与高估值科技受压，资金集中到少数能用指引兑现增长的公司。若10年期收益率回落且QQQ不再创新低，财报强势股可延续相对收益。

不确定性：10:00 ET工厂订单、14:00 ET褐皮书及美伊消息都可能改变节奏。MDB、PANW、CRDO证明beat不等于上涨，开盘后应以缺口保持和相对强弱验收。

重点个股推荐

GitLab
GTLB
财报最强

推荐理由：Q2收入增21%、净ARR增长超过40%，盘前约涨20.9%、成交约12.9万股，基本面与价格反馈同向。

触发因素：开盘守住54美元且前30分钟缺口保持过半，成交继续放大并强于软件ETF。

风险点：Q3收入指引仅2.81亿至2.83亿美元，高开后若跌破53美元，可能转为获利回吐。

Dell Technologies
DELL
大幅上调

推荐理由：收入、EPS和全年指引全面上调，盘前约涨9.1%、成交约20.3万股，AI服务器需求获得价格确认。

触发因素：开盘守住460美元并重新站上盘前高点，回踩时量缩而非放量失守。

风险点：AI服务器混合毛利、供应链占款和创纪录涨幅后的兑现压力；失守455美元则降级。

Hewlett Packard Enterprise
HPE
正向映射

推荐理由：Dell强劲业绩形成AI基础设施映射，Yahoo延迟盘前数据约涨4%，相对纳指显著走强；盘前量能未可靠提供，不写作放量。

触发因素：守住52.5美元且开盘后继续强于DELL以外的硬件同业；只做日内，盘后财报前控制敞口。

风险点：今晚财报、内存与芯片供给约束、Juniper整合和高开低走；失守51.8美元即退出观察。

NetApp
NTAP
存储映射

推荐理由：企业存储受Dell指引带动，Yahoo延迟盘前数据约涨1.6%、强于纳指；盘前量能未知，因此按条件式推荐处理。

触发因素：守住185美元并在开盘15分钟后仍为正收益，硬件板块维持相对强势。

风险点：今晚财报、估值已偏高且近30天存在一次下修；若跌回183美元以下，停止追多。

板块轮动看板

强势观察财报强势股与AI硬件映射：GTLB、DELL领涨，HPE、NTAP获得正向读穿。
事件驱动今晚AVGO、SNOW、HPE、NTAP、NTSK财报；只在价格确认后交易，不预设beat等于上涨。
压力方向高久期软件、半导体与高估值网安；MDB、PANW、CRDO均因负反馈只观察/回避追多。
验证信号10年期收益率能否跌回4.80%下方、纳指期货能否收复平盘，以及GTLB/DELL缺口能否保持。

逻辑链

美伊互相打击抬高霍尔木兹供应风险，Brent升至约95美元，能源通胀尾部风险扩大。
油价与财政担忧推动全球债券继续抛售，美国10年期收益率逼近4.82%。
更高贴现率压制纳指与半导体；ADP疲弱又强化增长担忧，指数缺少全面反弹条件。
资金因此集中到GTLB、DELL等用业绩和指引兑现增长的标的；开盘判断取决于收益率回落与财报缺口保持。

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下概率基于一致预期、历史surprise、近期指引、卖方修正、行业景气与盘前反馈，是判断而非确定事实；五家公司均已由公司IR或多份日历确认将在9月2日盘后披露。

高概率 64% · AVGO一致预期约EPS 3.21至3.24美元、收入292.5亿至294.4亿美元；上季EPS 2.44对2.39、收入221.9亿对221.3亿均超预期，AI半导体收入同比增143%，Susquehanna预期AI网络与软件带来小幅上行。风险是上季beat后股价仍跌12.6%，市场更关注下一季AI收入、供应与利润率。
高概率 61% · SNOW一致预期约EPS 0.45至0.47美元、收入14.8亿美元；上季收入13.9亿美元、同比增33%，产品收入增34%，公司给出的Q2产品收入指引为14.15亿至14.20亿美元。过去一个月EPS一致预期上修约1.11%，Jefferies渠道调查偏正面。风险是高估值、较高比较基数与盘前约跌2.5%。
中概率 58% · HPE一致预期约EPS 0.93至0.94美元、收入119.1亿至120.1亿美元，对应公司0.88至0.93美元和115亿至121亿美元指引；BofA预计0.95美元、123亿美元并小幅上调全年展望。AI与网络需求支持，但内存、芯片供给和Juniper整合限制确定性；盘前约涨4%是正反馈。
中概率 55% · NTAP公开日历一致预期EPS约2.16美元；可比公开来源对收入预期不一致，因此不填单一数字。历史上最近8季有7季beat、平均surprise约4.2%，但近30天有一次盈利预期下修，且估值与技术位置偏高。盘前约涨1.6%提供轻微正反馈，指引仍决定反应。
低概率 46% · NTSK一致预期EPS约亏损0.07美元，公开收入预期分布约2.14亿至2.18亿美元；上季EPS亏损0.06美元，好于亏损0.07美元预期，公司此前实现首个全年正自由现金流。样本与卖方修正信息不足、盘前价格基本无变化，因此只给低概率并明确不确定性。

风险雷达

霍尔木兹升级

任何新的航运中断或军事报复都可能再次推高油价、收益率与通胀预期。

10年期突破4.82%

长债收益率若继续上行，高久期软件、半导体和小盘成长的估值压力会扩大。

beat仍遭抛售

MDB、PANW与CRDO均显示预期门槛高于当季数字；未止跌前只观察、回避追多。

日内事件跳变

10:00 ET工厂订单、14:00 ET褐皮书和突发地缘消息可快速反转低开后的节奏。

今晚财报集中

HPE与NTAP虽盘前走强但盘后披露；AVGO、SNOW与NTSK也有高波动，隔夜仓位须单独管理。

数据来源与时间点

来源与时点：Reuters（美伊冲突、Brent、美债收益率、ADP交叉核验）、AP（全球股市与亚洲跌幅）、ADP官方、Dell/GitLab/MongoDB/Broadcom/HPE/Netskope公司IR、TipRanks与Investing.com盘前行情及财报日历、Yahoo Finance延迟盘前图表。行情主要抓取于2026-09-02 20:45—20:50 CST（08:45—08:50 ET），页面更新2026-09-02 21:11 CST。Futu OpenD 127.0.0.1:11111连接超时，个别盘前量能不可得并已降级披露；所有beat概率均为判断，不是事实。
entries.html_en:
Key Asset Map

S&P 500 futures
-0.29% softer
Nasdaq 100 futures
-0.55% tech pressure
Dow futures
-0.16% resilient
Brent crude
+0.60% inflation risk
U.S. 10-year yield
4.82% valuation drag
Semiconductor ETF SMH
cash close -2.04%

Keyword Cloud

Oil shockBond routTech pressureGTLB earningsDELL raiseMDB selloffCRDO marginsPANW punishedADP slowdownAVGO reportSNOW usageStagflation trade
BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not percentage change.
Major News Roundup
Geo
U.S.-Iran strikes intensify; Brent reaches about $95.18
Reuters reported at 7:20 ET that the U.S. struck Iranian military targets near Hormuz and Iran said it hit U.S. assets in the region; Brent rose 0.6% to $95.18. The supply-risk premium is higher, likely reinforcing Treasury term premium, while the escalation path remains highly uncertain.
Bonds
Global bond selloff deepens; U.S. 10-year yield nears 4.82%
Reuters put the U.S. 10-year yield near 4.8182%, close to a three-year high, while Japan's 10-year stayed above 3% for a second day. Higher oil and fiscal concerns are hitting long-duration tech first; a break above 4.82% could deepen intraday multiple compression.
Data
ADP adds only 38,000, below forecast, but long yields stay high
ADP said August private payrolls rose 38,000, the slowest since January and below the 47,000-48,000 consensus; manufacturing lost 17,000 jobs and professional/business services lost 16,000. Softer hiring is dovish in isolation, but oil-driven inflation risk leaves markets with weak growth and still-high rates.
Futures
Futures soften without a breakdown; Nasdaq 100 still lags
Around 8:07 ET, TipRanks showed S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 and Dow futures down about 0.29%, 0.55% and 0.16%; AP also reported the Nikkei down 2.9% and Korea's KOSPI nearly 4%. Global de-risking is concentrated in chips and growth rather than a synchronized collapse across all sectors.
Earnings
Dell posts records and sharply raises outlook; shares rise about 9.1%
Dell's Q2 revenue reached $47.0 billion, up 58%, with non-GAAP EPS of $7.04; full-year revenue guidance rose to $192 billion and non-GAAP EPS to $25.50. TipRanks showed shares near $463.68, up 9.1% on about 203,000 premarket shares, aligning the fundamentals and price verdict.
Earnings
GitLab net ARR growth exceeds 40%; shares jump about 20.9%
GitLab's Q2 revenue was $286.3 million, up 21%, net ARR growth exceeded 40%, and non-GAAP operating margin was 15%; Q3 revenue guidance is $281-$283 million. TipRanks showed shares near $54.53, up 20.9% on about 129,000 premarket shares, the clearest positive tech-earnings verdict.
Earnings
MongoDB beats and raises, yet falls about 13.6% premarket
MongoDB's Q2 revenue rose 30% to $771.8 million and non-GAAP EPS reached $1.90, both ahead of expectations; full-year revenue guidance rose to $2.99-$3.03 billion. Yet shares fell to about $375.25 premarket, showing valuation, forward growth and high expectations outweighed the beat; treat it as a risk watch and avoid chasing longs.
Earnings
Palo Alto posts another beat but is sold as the platform bar stays high
Public results summaries put PANW EPS near $1.02 versus roughly $1.00 expected, with FY27 revenue guidance of $14.1-$14.2 billion; shares still fell about 2% premarket. High valuation, integration risk and a demanding platform-growth bar made the beat insufficient; wait for stabilization.
Earnings
Credo's rapid sales growth is eclipsed by margin guidance; shares fall about 8.8%
